command: Freeze a q128 prefill receipt before launching payload. Use batch1/sequence128, hidden1536, 12Q/2KV heads, D128, causal token order and the same deterministic target weights. The physical 16x32 array processes eight 16-row batches: Q=589824, K=98304, V=98304, O=589824, gate=3440640, up=3440640 and down=3440640 steps, total 11698176. Stream attention without score storage: 99072 causal head-token dot/online updates, 1536 reciprocals and 12288 O/L chunks. Create a machine-readable operation/step manifest and a synthesizable q128 trace controller first; then run restartable numerical payload phases that consume frozen hashes. Never multiply single-token cycles analytically into RTL-measured fields.
fixed_order: q128 split-half RoPE and post-RoPE GQA
q128 streamed causal M/L/O and O/L
success_condition: The q128 manifest and controller use exact causal counts; every numerical phase consumes and emits frozen hashes; no score matrix is materialized; measured Matrix/SFU/controller cycles remain separately classified; all 128 final-token vectors pass the operation-order model under CPU 8-25, max j4 and 10 GiB cap.
failure_policy: Do not derive q128 measurements by scaling target-token results, omit causal prefixes, replace 16-row physical batching with a software shortcut, materialize scores, relax first mismatches, or start q384 before q128 numerical and controller receipts both pass.
